source_service_review.verified_service: PMC Article Datasets Cloud service via HTTPS/S3
source_service_review.migration_note: PMC announced legacy distribution removal in August 2026; current Cloud page/README still document per-version PMC<PMCID>.<version>/PMC<PMCID>.<version>.xml objects and individual HTTPS/S3 retrieval. The retired OA Web Service is not used.
source_service_review.source_terms: The Cloud README requires clear NLM attribution and prohibits implying NLM/NIH/HHS endorsement. PMC states article license terms vary and the exact article license governs.

retrieval_protocol.method: Serial HTTPS GET for only the 21 frozen xml_https_url values
verify_each_object: downloaded byte length equals frozen xml_size_bytes
computed MD5 equals frozen xml_md5 and xml_s3_etag
compute and record SHA-256 after MD5 passes
retrieval_protocol.on_mismatch: Record failure, stop content parsing for that object, do not substitute another version, and preserve the candidate failure.
retrieval_protocol.local_storage: data/q10-source-005/raw/ (ignored by Git); never commit article XML or extracted corpus text.

article_level_rights_protocol.xml_license: Parse the exact version XML JATS permissions/license element. Require an explicit href equal to https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ and an article statement consistent with CC BY 4.0; fail on missing, conflicting, or unclear article-level rights.
article_level_rights_protocol.identity: Cross-check the XML PMCID and article title/DOI against the frozen candidate metadata.
article_level_rights_protocol.third_party: Exclude all figure/table/media/supplement/caption content from text extraction. Review permissions, license notes and body notices for separately licensed or untraceable third-party text; exclude the entire candidate if a body-text rights exception cannot be isolated.
article_level_rights_protocol.attribution: Preserve author list, title, journal citation, DOI, PMCID/version, exact license URL, source URL, source hashes and access date. Include the required NLM source acknowledgement in the local source manifest; do not imply NLM endorsement.
article_level_rights_protocol.minimum_documents: At least 20 complete, article-level rights-cleared documents must remain before deterministic preparation; otherwise stop with no substitutions.
article_level_rights_protocol.training_text: If rights pass, prepare only abstract and main-body prose; omit back matter, references, acknowledgements, permissions, all figure/table/caption/supplement/media content, and non-prose markup.

rights_protocol_amendments.source005_original_rule_preserved: The initial Q10-SOURCE-005 criterion required the literal HTTPS href https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/.
rights_protocol_amendments.amended_rule: For rights screening only, accept exactly either http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ or https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ as the JATS license href, with no port, query, fragment, credentials, or path variation. Preserve the raw href and normalize the HTTP form to the canonical HTTPS URL for comparison. Also require the article license text to identify CC BY 4.0, at least one exact canonical HTTPS CC BY 4.0 URI in the frozen OAI rights values, and no conflicting article-level license or restriction. Missing or ambiguous evidence still fails.

trigger_observation.xml_license_text_prefix: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ This is an open access article distributed under the terms of the Creative Commons Attribution License

rights_protocol_amendments.interpretation_basis: The official Creative Commons deed resolves the HTTP URL to its canonical HTTPS page and identifies the canonical HTTPS license URL. Treating the two exact URI forms as one URI identity is a narrow protocol interpretation, not a legal conclusion about any article or its contents.
